Two More Arrested in SSC GD Constable Exam Irregularities

Two more individuals have been arrested in connection with irregularities in the SSC GD Constable Exam 2026. Among those arrested is the director of the company responsible for selecting exam centers. The main accused in the hacking of the SSC GD exam, Arun Kumar alias Devil, has been arrested in Delhi's Shahbad Dairy area. The Uttar Pradesh STF stated that Devil was a hacker for a solver gang and had planned to commit fraud in the online examination.
